zeri_r.name: 泽丽·超限爆闪

keyTooltip.text:
泽丽放出一道电能新星，对附近的敌人们造成@TotalActiveDamage@魔法伤害。如果她命中了一名敌方英雄，就会获得持续@RDuration@秒的@BaseASPercent*100@%攻击速度和@BaseBonusMS*100@%移动速度。用一次攻击或技能命中一名敌方英雄时，会使这个技能的持续时间延长并添加一层持续@MaxHyperchargeDuration@秒的超负荷效果。暴击会添加额外的2层效果。每层效果提供@MSPercent*100@%移动速度。

在此期间，{{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}}会变为一个更快速的3连发，可对附近的敌人们连锁造成@ChainPhysicalDamage@物理伤害。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text:
这个攻击速度还会提升泽丽的最大攻击速度。连锁闪电可以暴击但不会施加附加效果。未充能的攻击不会获得层数或刷新这个技能。
这个技能的延长时长不能超出它的初始时长(@RDuration@秒)。

keySummary.text: 泽丽放出一道电能新星，并且自身进入超负荷状态，来获得伤害提升和可叠加的移动速度，并且这个状态可在她每次命中敌方英雄时刷新持续时间并变得更强。在超负荷状态下。【枪火迸射】会变成一个快速的3连发，并在敌人之间引发连锁闪电。

officialEvidence.name: Lightning Crash
officialEvidence.description: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.
officialEvidence.tooltip:
Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing {{ totalactivedamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains {{ baseaspercent*100 }}% Attack Speed and {{ basebonusms*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ rduration }} seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for {{ maxhyperchargeduration }} seconds. Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks. Each stack grants {{ mspercent*100 }}% Move Speed.

During this time, Burst Fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains {{ chainphysicaldamage }} physical damage to nearby enemies.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
